_comment: Generated by `task generate:tools-lock`. Pins the Node.js version and per-platform sha256 checksums Aileron's managed-toolchain devcontainer build (#1525) installs, so a build is reproducible and a tampered or drifted distribution archive is rejected at fetch time. The version pin lives alongside the @devcontainers/cli pin in runtime.go. Checksums are the bare lowercase hex sha256 Node publishes in its signed SHASUMS256.txt, keyed by the Node distribution platform token (e.g. darwin-arm64, linux-x64, win-x64). Unlike the agent-images lock, the Node toolchain has no floating fallback: a version pin with no checksums is rejected. Do not hand-edit; regenerate. See docs/development/sandbox-agent-images.md.
